name: actin beta
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ACTB encodes actin, cytoplasmic 1 [Cleaved into: Actin, cytoplasmic 1, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and transporter regulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Baraitser-Winter cerebrofrontofacial syndrome (autosomal dominant); Baraitser-Winter syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.
